name: Citadel Outlets
summary: This outdoor shopping center features a variety of popular brand-name outlet stores & restaurants.
description: Citadel Outlets is Los Angeles' premier outlet shopping destination featuring over 130 global brands and restaurants, housed in a distinctive Assyrian palace-inspired architectural setting. Located just minutes from downtown LA, LAX, and Southern California attractions, this center offers exceptional value on designer and brand-name merchandise from retailers like Coach, Michael Kors, Nike, lululemon, and Tory Burch. The center provides a unique shopping experience with daily deals, seasonal events, and a California Welcome Center catering to both locals and tourists.
demographics: Citadel Outlets attracts a diverse demographic mix including value-conscious shoppers, international tourists, and families from the greater Los Angeles area seeking premium brands at outlet prices. The primary trade area encompasses middle to upper-middle income households from Commerce, East Los Angeles, and surrounding communities, with a strong secondary market of tourists visiting Southern California attractions. Shoppers typically range from millennials to middle-aged consumers who appreciate brand-name quality at discounted prices, with particularly strong foot traffic from Asian and Hispanic markets given the center's proximity to diverse LA neighborhoods and its appeal as a tourist destination near LAX.
